title: Presales - ServiceNow
description:
ServiceNow Licensing, Pricing and Contract Analyst
   

  

**About The Role**
**ServiceNow Licensing, Pricing and Contract Analyst** 
 , you will make an impact by providing licensing advisory, pricing support, entitlement governance, and contracting operations for ServiceNow solutions. You will be a valued member of the ServiceNow Business Group and work collaboratively with Sales, Presales, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Delivery teams, MSP Licensing Support, and ServiceNow account stakeholders.
   

  

 In This Role, You Will
   

  

* Support ServiceNow licensing activities including product mapping, SKU identification, entitlement validation, and licensing recommendations.
* Partner with sales and presales teams to address licensing inquiries, customer requirements, subscription renewals, and commercial requests.
* Prepare pricing worksheets, quote comparisons, renewal analyses, and commercial documentation while validating quantities, contract terms, and pricing assumptions.
* Assist with contract documentation, approval tracking, version control, and maintenance of audit\-ready records related to licensing and subscription agreements.
* Monitor licensing requests, track open actions, prepare operational reports, and contribute to process improvement, governance, and automation initiatives.


 Work Model
   

  

 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a
 **hybrid position** 
 requiring attendance at a Cognizant office in
 **Bangalore or Chennai,** 
 based on business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programmes.
   

  

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.
   

  

 What You Need to Have to Be Considered
   

  

* Experience in software licensing, SaaS pricing, quote operations, software asset management, renewals, commercial operations, or related functions.
* Good understanding of ServiceNow licensing models, subscriptions, pricing structures, entitlement management, and contracting processes.
* Experience preparing pricing analyses, quote comparisons, commercial documentation, and licensing support materials.
* Strong proficiency with spreadsheets, data validation, reporting, tracking tools, and structured documentation management.
* Excellent attention to detail, communication, stakeholder management, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Willingness to work during US business hours and provide extended support during critical business periods.


 These Will Help You Stand Out
   

  

* Knowledge of Managed Service Provider (MSP) licensing models and governance processes.
* Experience supporting software renewals, subscription management, and entitlement compliance programmes.
* Familiarity with commercial contract review processes and cross\-functional collaboration with legal, procurement, and finance teams.
* Understanding of software asset management practices and licensing optimisation strategies.
* ServiceNow platform knowledge, certification, or related software asset management experience.


 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC299929
description:
**Description**
**About the Role \& Team**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high\-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI\-led engineering through hands\-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting\-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket\-bound Scrum cycles toward intent\-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production\-ready software.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications \& Experience**
**Must\-Have Attributes**
 Experience: 15\+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product\-side delivery.
   

  

 – SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
   

  

 Hands\-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE\-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI\-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
   

  

 Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
 Customer\-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high\-touch, customer\-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre\-Sales Engineering Leader).
   

  

 AI Governance \& Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI\-enabled enterprise systems.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Client Engagement \& Strategic Architecture


 – Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high\-value areas for AI\-led acceleration.
   

  

 – Design \& Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands\-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
   

  

 – Lead the Intent\-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent\-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
   

  

  

* Value Measurement \& Executive Alignment


 Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story\-to\-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
   

  

 Technical \& Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long\-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C\-level stakeholders.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing network \& Infrastructure Security transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on manager who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models).
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Lead incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Provide strategic guidance on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Design and implement AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Develop and deploy AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

 Typical work environment
   

  

* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model


**EY \| Building a better working world**

title: Innovation Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




 We invite you to join the ZEISS Innovation Hub Chennai to shape together with us the future of advanced frugal innovation. We are turning today’s research into tomorrow’s applications – together with academic partners, students and entrepreneurs. Located at the IIT Madras Research Park, you will work in direct neighborhood to a world\-leading universities and with many startups co\-located in this dynamic environment. You will:
 



 • Drive new topics under the umbrella of advanced frugal innovation, by identifying and evaluating opportunities in the innovation sweet spot of desirability, feasibility, and viability
 



 • Find and work with partners in these topics in close cooperation with ZEISS stakeholders
 



 • Conduct innovation and market studies, identify customer needs, and develop solution concepts as part of an interdisciplinary team
 



 • Initiate and steer projects (incl. external partners) in the development of novel solutions (e.g., proof\-of\-concept demonstrators) and ensure the transfer of relevant knowhow to ZEISS
 



 • Support the successful transfer of concepts, technologies, and solutions to ZEISS business units
 



 • Screen and evaluate startups with strategic relevance for the Inno Hub's topics
 



 • Develop new business and venturing proposals and ideally lead your topic through incubation with our internal venture unit
 



  





 ZEISS employees work in a place where expert knowledge and team spirit reign supreme. All of this is supported by a special ownership structure and the long\-term goal of the Carl Zeiss Foundation: to bring science and society into the future together.
 



  





**Job Requirements** 



1. Ideally looking for 8\-12 years of relevant experience, can extend to 17 years.
2. A university degree in Mechanical engineering, physics, material sciences, or other relevant STEM fields, ideally with a PhD/M. Tech
3. Good knowledge in Solid works/CAM/CAD.
4. Profound knowledge in mechanics (elasticity and plasticity), materials science, finite element modeling, manufacturing (additive and subtractive), and other relevant fields
5. Ideally experience in innovation management or (internal) venturing, relevant methodologies such as design thinking, business models, lean startup, and software’s such as Miro, Power BI, Sharp cloud etc. for visualizing idea funnels
6. An intrapreneurial mindset, a holistic view of innovation and a desire to take topics beyond technology to market success
7. Experience in project management
8. A “together we go far” (collaboration) and “just do it” (action\-bias) mindset
9. Passion for innovation and enthusiasm for new technologies as well as fun working in agile, interdisciplinary, and cross\-border teams
10. Ability to persevere in the process of idea creation and rejection, with a positive mindset

title: SAP IBP + OBP ( Consultant)
description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid role focuses on designing and optimizing SAP Integrated Business Planning solutions for supply chain operations in consumer goods. The Functional Lead will apply expertise in SAP IBP Demand Supply Inventory S and OP and Control Tower along with CPI DS to align planning processes with business goals. The role spans 6 to 10 years of experience and supports global day shift delivery without travel.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end SAP IBP design across Demand Supply Inventory S and OP and Control Tower to enable resilient and agile planning processes that directly support consumer goods supply chains
* Translate complex business requirements in supply chain management into integrated SAP IBP functional designs that improve forecast accuracy service levels and working capital outcomes
* Configure SAP IBP Demand and related demand planning processes to support statistical forecasting demand sensing and promotion planning tailored to consumer goods business scenarios
* Optimize SAP IBP Supply and Time Series Optimiser models to balance capacity constraints and service levels while minimizing cost and improving on time performance
* Implement SAP IBP Inventory planning strategies to reduce excess stock mitigate obsolescence risk and improve product availability across distribution networks in consumer goods environments
* Set up and refine SAP IBP S and OP cycles that align demand supply and financial plans enabling data driven decision making and improved consensus planning outcomes
* Design and maintain SAP IBP Control Tower scenarios and alerts to provide near real time visibility into supply chain exceptions and to orchestrate timely corrective actions
* Configure and support CPI DS integrations to ensure reliable and timely data flows between SAP IBP and source systems strengthening planning data quality and consistency
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders in supply chain finance sales and manufacturing to validate planning designs and ensure solutions meet operational and strategic objectives
* Conduct business workshops requirement gathering sessions and system demonstrations to guide stakeholders through best practices in integrated business planning for consumer goods
* Develop detailed functional specifications test scenarios and user acceptance criteria to ensure robust solution delivery and smooth adoption by planning and operations teams
* Provide ongoing application support issue resolution and continuous improvement enhancements for SAP IBP modules to keep planning capabilities aligned with evolving business needs
* Mentor junior practitioners on SAP IBP processes configuration practices and supply chain concepts so that the project team can deliver consistent and scalable outcomes

 Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Our approach integrates innovative, state\-of\-the\-art techniques with practical, tailor\-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurgaon, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Pune and Lucknow. Mercados has presence across the Energy Value Chain and serves Clients both in the public and private domain. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely ‘Management Consulting’ and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets \& Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

The role involves Business Development, selling Mercados' existing portfolio of solutions to new and existing clients, client leadership, team management, and quality assurance across projects, including bid process management for power procurement, evaluation of new initiatives, internal feasibility assessments, and preparation of concept notes and thought leadership papers. The AD/D is also expected to lead the development of high\-quality presentations for senior client leadership, conferences, webinars, and seminars.

* The Director / Associate Director will report to senior leadership and will have end\-to\-end ownership of business growth, client relationships, and project delivery, with a key focus on managing and expanding Mercados' presence in the Southern region market. Key expectations include:
* Drive business development in the Southern region, identifying new opportunities and building a strong pipeline of consulting mandates.
* Lead efforts to sell Mercados' existing portfolio of solutions and services to new and existing clients across the region.
* Lead and manage multiple ongoing and future consulting assignments in the power and renewable energy sector, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality outputs.
* Provide strategic advisory on energy policies, regulations, incentives, and reforms related to power generation, power procurement, and renewable energy.
* Oversee bid process management assignments for procurement of power by distribution licensees.
* Lead analysis of policy and regulatory developments and assess their implications on client businesses, providing actionable recommendations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients in the Southern region, leading discussions, meetings, and stakeholder engagements.
* Mentor and guide team members, review their work, and ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality in deliverables.
* Coordinate closely with internal teams to manage project execution, resolve issues, and maintain delivery schedules.
* Lead preparation and presentation of concept notes, thought leadership papers, and client presentations for senior management forums.
* Represent the organization in client meetings, conferences, workshops, and industry events across the Southern region, as required.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-ownership team culture aligned with organizational goals.



  





**D. Required skill set:** 



* Proven track record in business development, client acquisition, and revenue growth within a consulting or advisory environment, ideally within the Southern region market.
* Demonstrated ability to sell a portfolio of consulting solutions to new and existing clients, and to build long\-term senior client relationships.
* Proven ability to lead multiple consulting engagements and manage complex assignments in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Strong understanding of the power sector value chain, with experience in at least two of the following areas — Power Markets, Power Distribution or Renewables— and the ability to translate this expertise into new business opportunities for the firm.
* Demonstrated experience working with a wide range of stakeholders, including Private, State, and Central Generators, Electricity Regulatory Commissions, Government bodies, and Power Utilities.
* Good understanding of the power sector landscape, including emerging policies and regulations, and their implications for clients.
* Excellent leadership, mentoring, and team management capabilities, with experience managing and growing consulting teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts and thought leadership clearly to senior stakeholders.
* High level of analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making ability.
* Proven ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and presentation tools (PowerPoint, Excel, etc.).
* Strong research orientation with the ability to translate insights into compelling client\-facing and thought leadership content.

* Sustainable

 across the assigned portfolio.

 **up\-selling and cross\-selling opportunities** 
 .

 Solutions Architecture

As a Business Acquisition Executive, you will serve as the first point of contact for prospective and existing Mutual Fund Distributors (MFDs) entering the AssetPlus ecosystem.

* Enrolment of Prospective MFDs into AssetPlus Academy

* The mutual fund distribution industry
* The benefits of becoming an MFD
* AssetPlus Academy’s training program
* The process of certification and onboarding


 You will conduct business opportunity presentations, platform demos, and qualification conversations to encourage candidates to enroll in the training program.
   

  

* Empanelment of Existing ARN Holders


 You will also engage with existing Mutual Fund Distributors and introduce them to the AssetPlus platform, helping them understand the value proposition and guiding them toward empanelment with AssetPlus.
   

  

 As the first level of interaction in the funnel, you will play a critical role in ensuring high\-quality lead qualification, timely follow\-ups, and smooth handoff to the onboarding team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Calling \& Qualification**
* Engage with marketing\-qualified leads (MQLs) through outbound calling and follow\-ups
* Qualify leads based on intent, profile fit, and readiness to proceed

**Business Opportunity Presentation \& Platform Demo**

* Educate prospects about:
* Mutual fund distribution as a career/business opportunity
* AssetPlus platform features and benefits
* Earning potential and growth opportunities
* Tailor conversations based on the prospect’s background


**Funnel Movement \& Follow\-Ups**
* Ensure timely engagement of all assigned leads within defined TATs

**CRM \& Operational Discipline**

* Keep activity trackers and reports updated on a daily/weekly/monthly basis


**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Strong communication and persuasion skills
* Comfortable handling high\-volume calling and follow\-ups
* Ability to conduct consultative conversations and demos confidently
* Experience in BFSI or financial services is a plus
* Familiarity with CRM tools and lead management processes is preferred
* Fluent communication in Hindi and English (additional regional languages are a plus)
* Proactive, adaptable, persistent, and target\-oriented mindset


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistently achieving SQL conversion and empanelment targets
* Driving strong funnel movement through timely follow\-ups
* Delivering high\-quality lead qualification
* Conducting impactful business opportunity presentations and demos
* Ensuring smooth handoff of qualified candidates to onboarding teams

 • An innovator who is not afraid to try new approaches

 • Proficiency in use of desktop software applications, such as MS office, LMS and CRM

title: Material Quotation Analyst
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market\-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
   

  

**Material Quotation Analyst I (G23\)**
**Position Summary**
 The Material Quotation Analyst is responsible for supporting Sales, Business Development, Supply Chain, and Customer Focus Teams by providing accurate and competitive material cost quotations. The role involves analyzing Bills of Materials (BOMs), sourcing component pricing, supporting RFQ activities, engaging with suppliers, and developing cost\-effective quotation packages that enhance customer satisfaction and drive business growth
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Quotation Management**
* Process customer and internal RFQ requests within defined timelines.
* Prepare material cost estimates and quotation packages for new business opportunities.
* Support Business Development and Sales teams with competitive costing solutions.
* Ensure quotation data accuracy and completeness prior to submission.


**Cost Analysis \& Supplier Engagement**
* Source and identify the most cost\-effective suppliers and material solutions.
* Obtain supplier quotations and validate pricing against market benchmarks.
* Support cost\-reduction initiatives through alternate sourcing, redesign recommendations, and process substitution opportunities.
* Collaborate with Commodity Managers and Procurement teams to optimize material costs.


**BOM \& Data Management**
* Review and validate customer Bill of Materials (BOMs).
* Upload and maintain BOM information in quotation management systems.
* Verify AVL/AML compliance and component lifecycle status where applicable.
* Ensure data integrity within quotation and ERP tools


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with Sales, Program Management, Procurement, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams.
* Coordinate with suppliers and material groups to gather pricing, lead\-time, and availability information.
* Provide timely responses to customer and internal quotation\-related inquiries.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Generate quotation status, pricing, and cost analysis reports.
* Track RFQ performance metrics and maintain quotation databases.
* Support management reporting through data collection and analysis.


**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Operations, or related discipline.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.


**Experience**
* 3\+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Costing, Quotation Management, or related functions.
* Experience in EMS, Manufacturing, Electronics, or Procurement environments is preferred.

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- SailPoint ISC Senior**

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 3\-7 years of experience in designing and deploying ISC\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions.
* Configure and manage SailPoint ISC tenant, including deployment of Virtual Appliances for secure connectivity between cloud and on\-premises environments
* Integrate of different auth sources and create identity profiles with transforms.
* Manage identity lifecycle through Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver processes.
* Develop workflows and custom forms for access requests and access review modules.
* Write and maintain Cloud Rules using Java/BeanShell for complex attribute transformations.
* Build and configure connectors for systems like Active Directory, Azure AD, Workday, Web Services, and JDBC.
* Work with SailPoint REST APIs for bulk operations, custom reporting, and external integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Demonstrate strong understanding of JSON, XML, REST/SOAP, and SCIM protocols.
* Stay updated on latest ISC modules and functionalities such as AI and CIEM.
* Sailpoint engineer certification is preferred


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
